scope: Sports, weather and news replacements relevant to PhilthySports. Not every API category in the directory.

providers.name: ESPN Site API
providers.purpose: Scores, schedules, injuries and current headlines
providers.note: Existing sports adapters retained; new dated headline endpoint, excluded from model features.

providers.name: NBA CDN LiveData
providers.purpose: NBA live scoreboard and box scores
providers.note: Existing live adapter retained. Separate full-season schedule URL returned 403 in this review; no new dependency on it.

providers.name: MLB StatsAPI
providers.purpose: Schedules, live scores, player data and venue coordinates
providers.note: Official venue metadata now supports weather for confirmed open-air venues.

providers.name: NHL Web API
providers.purpose: Schedule, live game centre and statistics
providers.note: Current Web API retained; older directory links are not treated as current endpoint specifications.

providers.name: nflreadpy / nflverse
providers.note: Already present in the historical collector. Data availability is not evidence of pregame provenance or model promotion.

providers.name: US National Weather Service
providers.note: Default weather provider. Excludes past events, stale forecasts and unconfirmed outdoor venues.

providers.name: Open-Meteo
providers.note: Set OPEN_METEO_ACCESS=noncommercial only for eligible non-commercial use. Off by default. No historical model features are inferred from current forecasts.

providers.name: DraftKings / Bovada public feeds
providers.purpose: Game odds and selected player props
providers.note: Existing adapters retained. Coverage, timestamps and complementary prices remain checked per event and market.

providers.name: The Odds API
providers.note: Still useful for coverage gaps. Rotation confirmation and entitlement checks remain required.

providers.name: APILayer Weatherstack
providers.note: Requires an account key and suitable forecast entitlement; does not remove key dependence. NWS used instead.

providers.name: APILayer Mediastack
providers.note: Requires a provider key; current sports headlines are available through the new ESPN adapter. Not a replacement for private X access.

providers.name: BALLDONTLIE
providers.note: Directory says no authentication; current NBA documentation requires an API key and paid access for odds/props.

providers.name: TheSportsDB
providers.note: Metadata option, not verified sportsbook player-prop coverage or a production shared-key solution.

providers.name: Odds-API.io
providers.note: Separate provider from The Odds API. Requires its own key, schema adapter and live coverage validation.

providers.name: FanLine Wire public snapshot
providers.note: Live request succeeded, but free rows lack selection labels, line handicaps and scheduled event time needed for safe market mapping.

providers.name: Bet Better / NoPunt
providers.note: Public model predictions are not trained PhilthySports weights, settled validation or calibrated promotion evidence.

credential_remediation.runtime_provider_key: ODDS_API_KEY is optional for the existing primary odds path; keyless coverage is not guaranteed complete.
credential_remediation.legacy_keys: Previously exposed Odds API, Sportradar, Visual Crossing, Google service-account, X and Twilio credentials still require revocation even when replaced.
credential_remediation.signing: Preserve the existing Android/model signing identity.
